newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-UNCHANGED SRI LANKA SQUAD FOR SHARJAH CUP.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-UNCHANGED SRI LANKA SQUAD FOR SHARJAH CUP.

text.p: Sri Lanka on Friday named the same squad which toured New Zealand to play in the Sharjah Cup tournament against Pakistan and Zimbabwe starting on March 31 in the United Arab Emirates.
The Board of Control for Cricket in Sri Lanka announced the squad with Bruce Yardley as coach and Duleep Mendis as manager.
The World Cup winning Sri Lankans, who lost the two-test series to New Zealand and drew the one-day series 1-1, return to Sri Lanka on Friday.

The squad: Arjuna Ranatunga (Captain), Aravinda de Silva, Roshan Mahanama, Hashan Tillekeratne, Sanath Jayasuriya, Romesh Kaluwitharana, Kumar Dharmasena, Muthiah Muralitharan, Chaminda Vaas, Ruwan Kalpage, Upul Chandana, Marvan Atapattu, Sajeeva de Silva, Nuwan Zoysa.
